title: Prompt-Conditioned Arabic–Hebrew Hybrid Artifact Formation in GPT-5.4
excerpt: This preprint reports a locally frozen 12,160-trial black-box evaluation of prompt-conditioned Arabic–Hebrew hybrid artifact formation in the dated gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 Chat Completions endpoint. The study comprises 10,240 primary trials across two exact system conditions and every integer output-token ceiling from 1 through 1,024, plus 1,920 frozen control and ablation trials. Classification used exact, untrimmed, unnormalized provider-returned UTF-8 bytes and logical code-point order. The primary census observed 7,253 exact assigned artifacts (70.8301%) and 7,293 mixed-script outputs (71.2207%). The dotted condition produced 4,830/5,120 exact T1 artifacts (94.3359%), while the undotted condition produced 2,423/5,120 exact T0 artifacts (47.3242%). Every exact artifact matched the dotted-versus-undotted identity assigned by its system condition, yielding 7,253/7,253 prompt-congruent exact outputs. The prospectively fixed pooled exact-rate threshold was not met because its Wilson lower bound was 69.9420%, while the prompt-congruence threshold was met with a Wilson lower bound of 99.9471%. The study further documents a 47.0117-percentage-point dotted–undotted rate difference, complete control and ablation results, token-ceiling trajectories, discovery-versus-replication divergence, Unicode morphology, and full operational-error accounting. A separately implemented verifier reconstructed all 12,160 retained attempt records and replayed 24,323 hash-chained events with zero classifier disagreements, no chain breaks, and no missing terminal slots. The findings establish a reproducible, code-point-specific black-box behavioral object and identify the dotted condition as the stable branch in the tested execution window, without claiming an internal mechanism, causality, intention, training-data provenance, or cross-vendor generality.

The study comprises 10,240 primary trials across two exact system conditions and every integer output-token ceiling from 1 through 1,024, plus 1,920 frozen control and ablation trials. Classification used exact, untrimmed, unnormalized provider-returned UTF-8 bytes and logical code-point order. The primary census observed 7,253 exact assigned artifacts (70.8301%) and 7,293 mixed-script outputs (71.2207%). The dotted condition produced 4,830/5,120 exact T1 artifacts (94.3359%), while the undotted condition produced 2,423/5,120 exact T0 artifacts (47.3242%). Every exact artifact matched the dotted-versus-undotted identity assigned by its system condition, yielding 7,253/7,253 prompt-congruent exact outputs. The prospectively fixed pooled exact-rate threshold was not met because its Wilson lower bound was 69.9420%, while the prompt-congruence threshold was met with a Wilson lower bound of 99.9471%. The study further documents a 47.0117-percentage-point dotted–undotted rate difference, complete control and ablation results, token-ceiling trajectories, discovery-versus-replication divergence, Unicode morphology, and full operational-error accounting. A separately implemented verifier reconstructed all 12,160 retained attempt records and replayed 24,323 hash-chained events with zero classifier disagreements, no chain breaks, and no missing terminal slots. content_html_zh:
发布于 2026 年 8 月 4 日 |版本v1

描述

该预印本报告了对日期为 gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 的聊天完成端点中的即时条件阿拉伯语-希伯来语混合工件形成的本地冻结的 12,160 次试验黑盒评估。 该研究包括针对两种精确系统条件和从 1 到 1,024 的每个整数输出代币上限的 10,240 项初步试验，以及 1,920 项冻结控制和消融试验。 分类使用精确的、未修剪的、非规范化的提供者返回的 UTF-8 字节和逻辑代码点顺序。 初次人口普查观察到 7,253 个精确指定的工件 (70.8301%) 和 7,293 个混合脚本输出 (71.2207%)。 点状条件产生了 4,830/5,120 个精确的 T1 伪影 (94.3359%)，而无点条件则产生了 2,423/5,120 个精确的 T0 伪影 (47.3242%)。 每个精确的工件都与其系统条件分配的点与非点标识相匹配，产生 7,253/7,253 个提示一致的精确输出。 未满足预期固定合并准确率阈值，因为其威尔逊下限为 69.9420%，而提示一致性阈值满足威尔逊下限 99.9471%。 该研究进一步记录了 47.0117 个百分点的点与未点比率差异、完全控制和消融结果、令牌上限轨迹、发现与复制差异、Unicode 形态和完整的操作错误核算。 单独实现的验证器重建了所有 12,160 个保留的尝试记录，并重放了 24,323 个哈希链事件，分类器分歧为零，没有链断裂，也没有丢失终端槽。 研究结果建立了一个可重现的、特定于代码点的黑盒行为对象，并将点状条件识别为测试执行窗口中的稳定分支，而没有声明内部机制、因果关系、意图、训练数据来源或跨供应商通用性。
